source_documents.title: Synergistic Diphenylboron and Heavy‐Atom Effect: A BF 2 ‐Free Strategy for Four‐Coordinated Boron Room‐Temperature Phosphorescence

reference_evidence_units.quote: PMB powder shows only a strong blue fluorescence band at 420 nm (Figure 2c and Table 1), with a fluorescence quantum yield (ΦF ) as high as 76.6%, and no phosphorescence signal is detected (Figure S17).
reference_evidence_units.subject: PMB
reference_evidence_units.statement: Bright fluorescence and no phosphorescence without bromine.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The same behavior is observed for PMB in its crystal and doped film (named PMB@PMMA) states, where only fluorescence is detected.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PMB
reference_evidence_units.statement: No RTP in any solid form.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Their fluorescence emission spectra are both broad and featureless, with peaks at 478 nm and 469 nm (Figure 2a,b), respectively, indicating intramolecular charge transfer (CT) character for their lowest singlet excited state.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PMB, PMB-Br
reference_evidence_units.statement: Broad, featureless fluorescence: S1 has CT character.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Spectral shape only here; NTO/hole-electron analysis supports it.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The introduction of the bromine atom endows the powder samples with green phosphorescence featuring a lifetime of 1.72 ms.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PMB-Br

reference_evidence_units.quote: Theoretical calculations reveal that the bromine atom intramolecularly enhances the key spin-orbit coupling (SOC) constant to 16.13 cm−1 , providing the core driving force for efficient intersystem crossing; simultaneously, it intermolecularly cooperates with BPh2 to construct a rigid network that stabilizes the excitons.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PMB-Br
reference_evidence_units.statement: Br raises S1-T2 SOC to 16.13 cm-1 and builds a rigid packing network.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Although the powder efficiency of PMB-Br is moderate (ΦP = 1.9%), the dramatically higher ΦP (7.3%) in PMB-Br@PMMA film confirms that the ISC process is highly efficient and that non-radiative decay is the primary bottleneck.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PMB-Br
reference_evidence_units.statement: ΦP rises from 1.9% to 7.3% when dispersed in PMMA.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This dense interaction network can effectively restrict molecular vibrations, providing crucial structural rigidity for stabilizing triplet excitons [43, 44].
reference_evidence_units.subject: PMB-Br

reference_evidence_units.quote: In aggregated states (powder or crystal), PMB-BF2 exhibits greenish-yellow RTP with τP = 2.05–3.85 ms and ΦP = 3.5–3.7%, which are slightly higher than those of PMB-Br.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PMB-BF2

reference_evidence_units.quote: Under these conditions, the ΦP of PMB-Br dramatically increases from 1.9% (powder) to 7.3% (PMB-Br@PMMA), whereas that of PMB-BF2 increases only modestly from 3.5% to 4.9%.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PMB-Br, PMB-BF2
reference_evidence_units.statement: Isolated in PMMA, PMB-Br outperforms PMB-BF2.

reference_evidence_units.quote: PMB-BF2 exhibits a maximum SOC of only 0.60 cm−1 (S1 –T2 )
reference_evidence_units.subject: PMB-BF2
reference_evidence_units.statement: Weak SOC for the BF2 analogue.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: S1 is CT while T2/T3 are CT+LE; the paper uses this El-Sayed-type change of character to explain the large SOC.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Powder RTP (1.72 ms) driven by bromine-enhanced SOC; ISC is efficient (ΦP 7.3% in PMMA).

environment_context: a dense Br/phenyl contact network in the crystal rigidifies the packing and stabilises triplets (E05, E07); no specific motion named; aggregation quenching is relieved in PMMA (E06)

contrast_group.varied_factor: bromine on the phenyl ring of the BPh2 phenylpyrimidine complex
contrast_group.paper_difference: PMB only fluoresces (ΦF 76.6%); PMB-Br shows RTP (1.72 ms) through heavy-atom SOC and a Br-mediated rigid packing.

basis: Figure 1c; structure recognition of the main text and SI drawings (Br para to the pyrimidine, meta to B)
